thread_text:
frank: Heads-up: finalizing v2.3.1 release notes + internal announce. Change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Need: 1-line blurb, deploybot commands, exact header to pin runtime, and a tiny ops checklist. Can someone own blast?

nina: Ill take the blast and RN bullets. Will post draft link in ~20m.

lee: Canary proposal: 10% 20m -> 50% 20m -> 100% 20m. Health gates: error_rate > 1.5% (5m) OR p95 delta > 90ms => pause. OOM spike => immediate pause + rollback.

sara: Add Dedicated note: set header `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f` to pin. Include SDK examples (curl + node).

deploybot: Suggested command: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10% --stages=50%,100% --stage-duration=20m` 

opsbot: Automation rules saved for this deploy: error_rate > 1.5% (5m), p95_delta > 90ms (5m), oom_count > 0 (2m). Auto-rollback if two rules fire.

nina: Draft blurb: "v2.3.1: KV-cache fixes + streaming token efficiency (~10% cost). Pinned runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f. Fallback: rif-quant-v2. Oncall: @lee @sara. See RN for rollback runbook and deploy commands."

frank: Please add copy/paste ops snippets (pause, rollback, pin) and observability queries into the RN.

lee: Ops snippets for RN: ```bash
# Pause rollout
/deploybot pause --id {{deploy_id}}
# Rollback to previous
/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0
# Pin runtime via Console API
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pins -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -d '{"runtime":"rif-runtime@3c7f"}'
```

sara: Observability quick-queries to include: `sum(rate(runtime_errors[5m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`. Also link to GPU memory panel.

nina: Posted draft: https://rwd.internal/releases/drafts/v2.3.1-final-review  will send internal announce at 22:40 UTC unless objections.

frank: Staging smoke go/no-go in 15m. If green, nina please blast and pin the runtime. Thanks all.
